seoTitle: Invoice Number Generator With Year Reset
metaDescription: Generate sequential invoice numbers with prefix, year, zero padding and an option to restart each year. Continues from your last number.
intro: Next invoice numbers in your format, continuing from the last one you issued.
why:
Invoice numbers must be unique and sequential in most countries. Typing them by hand invites duplicates and typos.

Set a prefix, separator, year style and padding. Paste the last number and the tool continues from it, or restarts at your start value when the year changes and you choose to reset.
howTo: Set prefix, separator, year style and digits.
Paste your last number, or leave empty.
